_comment: Flanking maneuver (#1018): an engaged unit expands its frontage to wrap around the opposing enemy line's flanks. One player Infantry regiment (team 0, 80 soldiers, natural 10-file frontage) faces an enemy Infantry regiment (team 1, 40 soldiers, 8-file frontage). At tick 8, the player selects the unit and issues Ctrl+F6 (Flanking maneuver). When the two lines close and engage in melee (~tick 150), the player unit reflows its frontage from 10 to 12 files (enemy frontage of 8 files + 4 wrap files), wrapping its outer ranks around the enemy line. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd. World coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
